brand: Lina S Lee Cards and Goods
tagline: Hand-painted cards, made in New York
homeIntro: Greeting cards and small goods painted by hand by one New York artist, for birthdays, thank-yous and every little occasion in between.
aboutParagraphs: Hi, I'm Lina S Lee, a New York artist who paints greeting cards by hand. Every card in the shop is painted in New York, one at a time, so no two are exactly alike.

My cards are built around the things people love to give each other: flowers for any day, fruit for fresh starts, cats and dogs for the ones who steal the show, and wine for the good nights worth a toast.
Besides cards, I make a small range of goods, including notebooks, t-shirts and scarves. Everything is made in small batches.
You can shop here, or find me in person at New York craft and maker markets. Check the Find Me in NYC page for upcoming dates.

faq.q: Are your cards really hand painted?
faq.a: Yes. Every card is painted by hand in New York by me, Lina S Lee.

faq.q: Where can I buy your cards in person?
faq.a: At New York craft and maker markets. Upcoming dates and locations are listed on the Find Me in NYC page.
Choose a card or product, then use the buy button on its page. If a product has no buy button yet, send me a message and I'll set it up for you.

faq.q: Can I ask for something custom?
faq.a: Yes, send me a note on the contact page with what you have in mind, such as a theme, an occasion, or a quantity for an event.

faq.q: What size are the cards, and do they come with envelopes?
faq.a: Size, paper and envelope details are listed on each product page.
